days.title: Day 1 — Setup & Core Basics
days.defaultGoal: Environment ready, first program compiled, comfortable with variables and basic syntax.

days.title: Day 2 — Control Flow & Functions
days.defaultGoal: Comfortable with conditionals, loops, functions, and how the compiler/linker pipeline works.

days.title: Day 3 — Arrays, Pointers & Memory
days.defaultGoal: Understand pointers, references, arrays, and stack vs heap memory at a working level.

days.title: Day 4 — Classes & Object-Oriented Basics
days.defaultGoal: Can write simple classes, understand constructors/destructors, and static vs instance members.

days.title: Day 5 — STL & Modern C++ Features
days.defaultGoal: Comfortable using STL containers, strings, and modern C++ conveniences in small programs.

days.title: Day 6 — Templates, Macros & Wrap-up
days.defaultGoal: Grasp templates/macros at a conceptual level and can navigate the rest of the series independently.
